verdict.rationale: Sketch's AI features (sketch.com/ai) generate concrete in-product suggestions from user data: auto-generated color palettes from a photo, context-aware placeholder text replacing lorem ipsum, automatic layer sorting/renaming, and dark-mode component swaps, plus an MCP server that lets AI clients act on design data directly inside Sketch. These are first-party docs describing AI-generated insights/suggestions operating on the user's own design content, matching the story well. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports validating these AI features' quality or reliability, and no evidence of broader analytical insights (e.g., usability or trend analysis) beyond generative/organizational suggestions.
